name: Wanderburg — Low-poly 3D (shipped)
description: THE presentation the game ships: a perspective camera over the rolling fortress, hand-built low-poly meshes, toon bands with environment ink edges, no silhouette outline (on convex hand-built meshes the inverted hull wins the depth tie and paints the object black), no shadow map — every hull drops its own blob shadow. Sun, sky and fog come from the biome (js/Content.js), so the variant pins only the shading model. Camera pose and the zoom range mirror Constants.js (CAMERA_*); the zoom itself stays authored by the game (CAMERA_ZOOM / CAMERA_ZOOM_MOBILE). Every entity is SELF-PRESENTED (GAME_SPEC.entities declare representation "none"): js/WanderView.js + js/WanderMesh.js build the meshes on the kit engine layer, so the pipeline binds no second copy of anything.
